comments.author: @shane5003
comments.text: Okay, I teach music production and produce for a living and invented some gear in the past and so I can I think speak with more expertise than a lot of the comments I've read here. Suno has been excellent compositionally for a while, but the audio quality isn't even close to there. You can't really tell this because you're listening on a YouTube video and you expect everything to sound like smeary mp3 compression anyway, but if you listen to the reverbs and the snare drums, basically anything where the signal gets low and it has to differentiate between silence and noise, it sounds like a big phasey wash. The voices also have the same issue when it comes to the unvoiced or noise components of the voice. Now the thing is that this kind of distortion of the signal is similar to what ends up happening when you have to try to compress a signal and then re-represent it because effectively that's what the AI is doing. It's hallucinating from the corpus using a diffusion model and extrapolating the signal from the noise. You see ? It’s like reconstituting from the compression. I don't know how it gets to a point where it doesn't sound like that shitty compression because it sounded like that the whole time. Now arrangement-wise it's very good and I can tell you I have a lot of students who if they were just starting now probably would have already given up because that kind of level of structural development and sense of harmony is not something that most people are born with and it just takes a while to learn and it's a big hurdle for a lot of people. Finally, there is sort of a give compositionally in the melodic movement of the monophonic lines and the voices. They tend to do a lot of trills and unusual interval jumps which give a wow factor but are actually beyond the skill level of a lot of singers. If you're doing an octave and a third jump and perfectly landing you're already in the top five percent of singers if you're dead on pitch with that rather than doing a pitch discovery into the final interval. So you'll hear that kind of stuff and I'm sure it could be nudged out of the system but it's one of the things that people really react strongly to so I think that it biases itself in that direction but it is in fact a give.
